# Lab 7.3: Data Transfer Service: Cloud Storage

## What We Are Going to Do
Set up a recurring transfer that loads new CSV files from a Cloud Storage folder into a partitioned table.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Put files in a landing folder.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">export BUCKET=$PROJECT_ID-bq-labs
printf "sale_id,city,amount,sale_date\n1,Surat,120.5,2026-11-01\n2,Pune,99.0,2026-11-01\n" &gt; sales_1.csv
printf "sale_id,city,amount,sale_date\n3,Delhi,300.0,2026-11-02\n" &gt; sales_2.csv
gcloud storage cp sales_*.csv gs://$BUCKET/incoming/</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Create the destination table.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE TABLE lab07.sales (sale_id INT64, city STRING, amount NUMERIC, sale_date DATE)
PARTITION BY sale_date;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[Console] Create the transfer.** **Pipelines and connections → Create → Load data → Google Cloud Storage**:
   - **Display name**: `gcs_sales`
   - **Schedule**: every 15 minutes (the minimum)
   - **Destination table**: `lab07.sales`
   - **Cloud Storage URI**: `gs://YOUR_BUCKET/incoming/*.csv`
   - **Write preference**: APPEND
   - **File format**: CSV, **Header rows to skip**: 1

4. **[CLI] The same transfer from the CLI.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq mk --transfer_config --data_source=google_cloud_storage --target_dataset=lab07 \
  --display_name=gcs_sales_cli --schedule="every 24 hours" \
  --params="{\"data_path_template\":\"gs://$BUCKET/incoming/*.csv\",
             \"destination_table_name_template\":\"sales\",
             \"file_format\":\"CSV\",\"skip_leading_rows\":\"1\",
             \"write_disposition\":\"APPEND\"}"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[Console] Run it now.** Open the transfer and click **Run transfer now**. Then query:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT * FROM lab07.sales ORDER BY sale_id;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Only files changed since the last run are loaded next time.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Transfer | Loads new files on a schedule |
| Minimum interval | 15 minutes |
| Destination | Partitioned `lab07.sales` |
| Delete the CLI copy | Keep one transfer to avoid double loads |
